coursework.en: Course AI authorization is set by the instructor; follow the syllabus for assessed work.
coursework.zh: 课程作业的AI许可由任课教师确定，评估性作业应遵守课程大纲。

exams.en: Do not assume AI is permitted in an exam; verify the instructor’s authorization for that assessment.
exams.zh: 考试不能根据工具可用性推断允许AI；须确认对应考试的教师授权。

disclosure.en: No universal student AI-disclosure format has been verified; follow course-specific requirements.
disclosure.zh: 尚未核实全校统一的学生AI披露格式，应遵守具体课程要求。

privacy_data.en: Sensitive or Restricted Data requires both a tool approved for that data category and a use case approved by the Data Ethics Committee.
privacy_data.zh: 敏感或受限数据须同时满足工具获准处理该数据等级及使用场景获数据伦理委员会批准。

approved_tools.en: The Enterprise AI Toolkit distinguishes product, account, cost and data category. Confirm the complete product entry and any required use-case approval before use.
approved_tools.zh: Enterprise AI Toolkit按产品区分账号、费用与数据等级；使用前须核对完整产品条目及必要的场景审批。

research_publication.en: AI outputs must be reviewed for accuracy, citation, restricted data and bias before sharing or publication.
research_publication.zh: 发布或分享AI生成内容前须核实准确性、引注、受限数据与偏见。

academic_integrity.en: Follow instructor authorization for academic work. Final-course-grade appeals and student-conduct appeals are separate procedures; do not transfer their deadlines between them.
academic_integrity.zh: 学术作品须遵循教师许可；最终课程成绩申诉与学生纪律申诉是不同程序，不得混用期限。

teaching_guidance.en: Instructors should state AI authorization and syllabus guidance for assessed and non-assessed work.
teaching_guidance.zh: 教师应明确AI许可，并在大纲中说明评估性及非评估性活动的要求。

security_procurement.en: Unlisted AI tools require IT solutions review, and applicable use cases require Data Ethics Committee review.
security_procurement.zh: 未列入批准清单的AI工具需要IT方案审查，符合条件的使用场景还须数据伦理委员会审查。

do.en: Read the syllabus and ask the instructor before using AI in assessed work.
do.zh: 评估作业使用AI前查看课程大纲并向任课教师确认。

do.en: Check the tool-specific data-classification permissions and required approvals.
do.zh: 按工具逐项检查数据等级和必要的审批。

do.en: Review accuracy and citations before sharing AI-generated output.
do.zh: 对外分享AI生成内容之前核查准确性和引用。

dont.en: Do not enter Sensitive or Restricted Data without the required tool and use-case approvals.
dont.zh: 未经对应工具及使用场景批准，不要输入敏感或受限数据。

dont.en: Do not assume a Purdue-provided AI account authorizes use in an assignment or exam.
dont.zh: 不要将获得Purdue工具账号等同于作业或考试许可。

dont.en: Do not treat AI output as the sole basis for personnel, award or disciplinary decisions.
dont.zh: 不得把AI输出作为人事、奖项或纪律决定的唯一依据。

coursework.en: Course AI authorization is set by the instructor; follow the syllabus for assessed work.
coursework.zh: 课程作业的AI许可由任课教师确定，评估性作业应遵守课程大纲。
coursework.meaningEn: Course authorization and University AI policy VII.A.5 revised 10 February 2026; data-use approval, tool eligibility, final-grade appeals and conduct appeals are distinct.
coursework.meaningZh: 课程使用许可与2026年2月10日修订的VII.A.5政策分别适用；数据使用审批、工具资格、最终成绩申诉及纪律申诉须分开核对。

exams.en: Do not assume AI is permitted in an exam; verify the instructor’s authorization for that assessment.
exams.zh: 考试不能根据工具可用性推断允许AI；须确认对应考试的教师授权。
exams.meaningEn: Course authorization and University AI policy VII.A.5 revised 10 February 2026; data-use approval, tool eligibility, final-grade appeals and conduct appeals are distinct.
exams.meaningZh: 课程使用许可与2026年2月10日修订的VII.A.5政策分别适用；数据使用审批、工具资格、最终成绩申诉及纪律申诉须分开核对。

disclosure.en: No universal student AI-disclosure format has been verified; follow course-specific requirements.
disclosure.zh: 尚未核实全校统一的学生AI披露格式，应遵守具体课程要求。
disclosure.meaningEn: Course authorization and University AI policy VII.A.5 revised 10 February 2026; data-use approval, tool eligibility, final-grade appeals and conduct appeals are distinct.
disclosure.meaningZh: 课程使用许可与2026年2月10日修订的VII.A.5政策分别适用；数据使用审批、工具资格、最终成绩申诉及纪律申诉须分开核对。

privacy_data.en: Sensitive or Restricted Data requires both a tool approved for that data category and a use case approved by the Data Ethics Committee.
privacy_data.zh: 敏感或受限数据须同时满足工具获准处理该数据等级及使用场景获数据伦理委员会批准。
privacy_data.meaningEn: University AI users; data category, product and approved use-case conditions apply.
privacy_data.meaningZh: 大学AI使用者；须逐项核对数据等级、产品及使用场景审批条件。

approved_tools.en: The Enterprise AI Toolkit distinguishes product, account, cost and data category. Confirm the complete product entry and any required use-case approval before use.
approved_tools.zh: Enterprise AI Toolkit按产品区分账号、费用与数据等级；使用前须核对完整产品条目及必要的场景审批。
approved_tools.meaningEn: University AI users; data category, product and approved use-case conditions apply.
approved_tools.meaningZh: 大学AI使用者；须逐项核对数据等级、产品及使用场景审批条件。

research_publication.en: AI outputs must be reviewed for accuracy, citation, restricted data and bias before sharing or publication.
research_publication.zh: 发布或分享AI生成内容前须核实准确性、引注、受限数据与偏见。
research_publication.meaningEn: University AI users; data category, product and approved use-case conditions apply.
research_publication.meaningZh: 大学AI使用者；须逐项核对数据等级、产品及使用场景审批条件。

academic_integrity.en: Follow instructor authorization for academic work. Final-course-grade appeals and student-conduct appeals are separate procedures; do not transfer their deadlines between them.
academic_integrity.zh: 学术作品须遵循教师许可；最终课程成绩申诉与学生纪律申诉是不同程序，不得混用期限。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: Course authorization and University AI policy VII.A.5 revised 10 February 2026; data-use approval, tool eligibility, final-grade appeals and conduct appeals are distinct.
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 课程使用许可与2026年2月10日修订的VII.A.5政策分别适用；数据使用审批、工具资格、最终成绩申诉及纪律申诉须分开核对。

teaching_guidance.en: Instructors should state AI authorization and syllabus guidance for assessed and non-assessed work.
teaching_guidance.zh: 教师应明确AI许可，并在大纲中说明评估性及非评估性活动的要求。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: Course authorization and University AI policy VII.A.5 revised 10 February 2026; data-use approval, tool eligibility, final-grade appeals and conduct appeals are distinct.
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 课程使用许可与2026年2月10日修订的VII.A.5政策分别适用；数据使用审批、工具资格、最终成绩申诉及纪律申诉须分开核对。

security_procurement.en: Unlisted AI tools require IT solutions review, and applicable use cases require Data Ethics Committee review.
security_procurement.zh: 未列入批准清单的AI工具需要IT方案审查，符合条件的使用场景还须数据伦理委员会审查。
security_procurement.meaningEn: University AI users; data category, product and approved use-case conditions apply.
